fun.jokes:
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs.
---
I told my computer I needed a break, and it said: no problem, I will go to sleep.
---
There are 10 kinds of people: those who understand binary and those who don't.
---

---
I would tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it.
---
What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta.
---

---

---

help.member: 📖 Commands Rules — the group rules Link — the group link Id / Info — your profile (or reply to someone) JoinDate — when you joined UserStats — your activity this week Time — date and time Report — reply to a bad message to alert the admins SetAsl … / MyAsl / Asl / DelAsl — your profile card Nickname / NicknameList GetPro 2 — profile photos Font text — fancy fonts Echo text · Joke Commands work in English and Persian.
help.locks: 🔒 Locks Lock X blocks something, Unlock X allows it again. Locked messages from ordinary members are deleted. X can be Text: Link, Hyper, Username, Hashtag, Text, Persian, English, Badword, Command, Spoiler, Emoji, JustEmoji, OneEmoji, Duplicate Media: Media, Photo, Video, Gif, Sticker, AnimatedSticker, Document, Audio, Voice, VideoNote, Contact, Location, Game Other: Forward, Inline, TgService, Bot, BotAdder, Edit, EditMedia, Pin, Cmd Examples Lock Link — delete links Lock Media 2 h — block media for two hours Lock TMedia 15 — media is deleted 15 minutes after it is sent · Unlock TMedia Lock Group · Lock Group 30 m · Unlock Group SetAutoLock 00:00 08:00 — close the group every night Or use the buttons: Panel → Locks.
help.protect: 🛡 Protection Anti-flood: Flood On, FloodCount 5, FloodMode TMute|Mute|Warn|Ban Slow mode: Limit On, LimitCount 10, LimitTime 60 Length: SetMaxChar 500, SetMinChar 2, Unlock Char Strict mode: Strict On, Lock Strict Link, StrictMode Warn|Mute|Ban, StrictMute 30 Captcha: Captcha On, CaptchaTime 3 Anti-tabchi: Lock Tabchi, Lock Advertiser, Lock Bio, TabchiMode Ban|Mute, TabchiTime Join|Message Duplicates: Lock Duplicate, DupTime 12, DupLen 30 Anti-betrayal: AntiBetrayal On, BetrayalLimit 10 Notices: DelReason On, ReportMode Group|PV Log channel: SetLog @channel records every action · RemLog
help.ranks: 🎖 Ranks 👑 Creator › 🎖 Owner › 🛡 Moderator › ⭐️ VIP › 🕊 Exempt › 👤 Member Telegram admins count as moderators. SetOwner · RemOwner — creator only Promote · Demote — moderator SetTempMod 2 d — moderator for two days SetVIP · RemVIP · SetTempVIP 7 d Exempt · RemExempt AddAdmin · RemAdmin — Telegram admin rights Lists: OwnerList, ModList, VIPList, ExemptList, AdminList Clear: Clean ModList, Clean VIPList, Clean ExemptList Time units: m (minutes), h, d, w.
help.punish: ⚖️ Punishments Reply to the member's message, or add their @username or id. Ban — remove and block · UnBan Ban+ — ban silently and delete both messages (owners) Mute — forever · Mute 30 · Mute 5 h · UnMute Kick — remove; they may join again Warn — add a warning · RemWarn · RemWarns SetWarn 3 — warnings before the punishment SetWarnBan · SetWarnMute — what happens at the limit UserPanel — buttons for one member Lists: BanList, SilentList, WarnList Clear: Clean BanList, Clean SilentList, Clean WarnList
help.words: 💬 Filters and auto answers Filters AddFilter word — delete messages with the word FilterWarn word · FilterMute word · FilterBan word — also punish RemFilter word · FilterList · Clean FilterList Filter — then send one word per message; FilterEnd to stop Panel PV — manage filters in private Auto answers Reply to a message with SetAnswer hello, or send SetAnswer hello | Hi there! Up to 20 answers per keyword; one is picked at random. AnswerAudience hello All|Ranked|Owners AnswerCooldown 30 · AnswerList · RemAnswer hello
help.join: 🚪 Joining Welcome: Welcome On, SetWelcome …, SetWelcomeMedia (reply), SetWelcomeTime 60, GetWelcome, ReSetWelcome Goodbye: Goodbye On, SetGoodbye … Variables: !mention !firstname !lastname !username !userid !groupname !grouplink !grouprules !date !time !emoji Force add: ForceAdd On, SetForceAdd 3, ForceAddTime 30, ForceAddStatus All|New, SetForceAddText …, CleanForceAdd Force join: SetForceJoinChannel @channel, ForceJoin On, SetForceJoinText …, ForceJoinStatus Captcha: Captcha On, CaptchaTime 3
help.stats: 📊 Statistics Stats — today and the week's top 10 Stats 30 mem — the week's top 30 WeeklyStats — messages per day TotalStats — since the bot joined AddStats — who added the most people RankStats — the admins' activity UserStats — one member (reply) SetAutoStats 21:00 — post a report every day · RemAutoStats
help.clean: 🧹 Cleaning Del 50 — delete the last 50 messages SetAutoClean 04:00 16:00 — clean the history up to 5 times a day · RemAutoClean Clean Bots — remove bots that are not admins Clean DeleteList — remove deleted accounts Clean Fake — remove fake accounts Clean BlockList — unban everyone Clean RestrictList — lift all restrictions Clean Nicknames — remove all nicknames
help.tools: 🧰 Tools Rules · SetRules … · DelRules Link · SetLink … · CreateLink · DelLink Pin (reply) · Pin 15 — for 15 minutes · Unpin SetPhoto — reply to a photo Tag — mention the active members Id · Info · JoinDate · GetPro 2 SetNickname … · Nickname · NicknameList SetAsl … · Asl · MyAsl · DelAsl Time · Font text · Echo text · Joke Report — members report a message to the admins Lock Cmd — tools only for VIPs and admins
help.texts: 🌐 Language and texts Lang — list languages · Lang fa · Lang en TimeZone +3:30 — for times and daily schedules SetText key text — rewrite any bot message (or reply to a formatted message) RemText key — back to the default TextKeys — all keys Example: SetText lock.on 🔐 {name} is now forbidden
ui.main: ⚙️ Control panel Choose a section. Every section explains what it does and lets you change it with buttons. 🔒 Locks — what members may not send 🛡 Protection — anti-flood, captcha, anti-tabchi and more 👥 Members — ranks, lists and warnings 🚪 Joining — welcome, captcha, force add and force join 💬 Words — filtered words and auto answers 📊 Statistics — who is active 🧹 Cleaning — remove bots, deleted and fake accounts 🌐 Language — the bot's language and texts 📖 Help — every command with examples
ui.expired: This panel is outdated. Send Panel to open a new one.
ui.locks: 🔒 Locks — {page} ({n}/{total}) Tap an item to switch it: ✅ locked, ❌ allowed. When ordinary members send something locked, it is deleted right away. Admins and VIP members are never affected. {hint}
ui.locks_hint_0: 💡 Links: web and Telegram links · Hyperlinks: words with a hidden link · Usernames: @ids · Commands: messages starting with / · Emoji-only: messages made only of emoji · Single emoji: exactly one emoji · Duplicates: repeated texts (settings under Protection).
ui.locks_hint_1: 💡 Media locks every kind at once. Lock it for a while with Lock Media 2 h, or let media disappear some minutes after it is sent with Lock TMedia 15.
ui.locks_hint_2: 💡 Service messages: join, leave and pin notices · Bots: bots added by members are removed · Bot adders: members who add a bot lose the right to add people · Editing: edited messages are deleted · Channel pins: posts auto-pinned from the linked channel are unpinned · Public commands: fun commands only for VIPs and admins · Tabchi, advertisers, links in bio: see Protection.
ui.protect: 🛡 Protection Automatic defenses against spam, raids and abuse. ✅ means active; open an item for its explanation and settings. 🔐 Group lock — close the chat for everyone but admins 🌊 Anti-flood — punish rapid-fire messages ⏳ Slow mode — a message quota per member 📏 Length — minimum and maximum message length ⚖️ Strict mode — punish, not only delete 🤖 Captcha — prove new members are human 🕵️ Anti-tabchi — catch advertising accounts ♻️ Duplicates — stop repeated banners 🚨 Anti-betrayal — stop an admin from mass-banning 💡 Notices — deletion reasons and reports
ui.captcha: 🤖 Captcha New members are muted until they answer a simple sum with the buttons. A wrong answer, or no answer in time, removes them from the group (they may join again). State: {state} Time to answer: {minutes} minutes
ui.tabchi: 🕵️ Anti-tabchi Catches accounts made for advertising: • Tabchi: a link or @id in the name, or adding bots • Advertisers: a link, @id or forward as a new member's first message • Links in bio: a link or @id in the profile bio Punishment: {mode} Checked: {timing}
ui.members: 👥 Members and ranks Ranks, from high to low: 👑 Creator › 🎖 Owner › 🛡 Moderator › ⭐️ VIP › 🕊 Exempt › 👤 Member • VIP: not affected by locks • Exempt: not affected by force add and force join Managing a member: reply to their message with UserPanel, or use Ban, Mute 30, Kick, Warn, Promote, SetVIP. Warnings: after {max} warnings → {action}
ui.fjoin: 📢 Force join Members must join the channel below before they can write. The bot must be an admin of that channel to check memberships. State: {state} Channel: {channel} • Set the channel: SetForceJoinChannel @channel • Private channel: SetForceJoinChannel -100… https://t.me/+… • Reminder text: SetForceJoinText …
ui.words: 💬 Words 🚫 Filters — messages containing a filtered word are deleted; the sender can also be warned, muted or banned. • AddFilter word · FilterWarn word · FilterMute word · FilterBan word · RemFilter word • Many at once: Filter, then one word per message, then FilterEnd 🤖 Auto answers — when someone writes a keyword, the bot replies with one of its answers (text or media, chosen at random). • Reply to the answer: SetAnswer keyword, or SetAnswer keyword | answer • Who triggers it: AnswerAudience keyword All|Ranked|Owners Filtered words: {filters} · Keywords: {answers} The same answer repeats at most every {cooldown} seconds.
ui.stats: 📊 Statistics Choose a report: • Summary: today's messages and the week's most active • Weekly: messages per day • All time: totals since the bot joined • Inviters: who added the most people • Staff: the admins' activity Daily report: {auto} (SetAutoStats 21:00)
ui.clean: 🧹 Cleaning These run over the whole member list and may take a few minutes. You will be asked to confirm. 🤖 Bots: remove bots that are not admins 👻 Deleted accounts: remove deleted accounts 🎭 Fake accounts: remove accounts without photo or username that have not been online for a month ⛔️ Banned list: unban everyone in Telegram's banned list 🔇 Restricted list: lift every restriction Delete recent messages: Del 50 Scheduled history cleaning: {auto} (SetAutoClean 04:00)
ui.clean_confirm: ⚠️ Run {action} now? This cannot be undone.
ui.lang: 🌐 Language The language of the bot's messages in this group (only owners can change it). Commands work in every language. Current: {current} Time zone: UTC{tz} (TimeZone +3:30) Custom texts: any bot message can be rewritten for this group with SetText key text. TextKeys lists the keys and RemText key restores the default.
ui.help: 📖 Commands Choose a topic. Every command works in English and in Persian. To act on a member, reply to their message or write their @username or numeric id after the command.
